notes.text: 46. Pl. XXXIV–XXXV: IM 21180x; epic of Gilgameš. It is the passage of the cutting of the cedar in order to float it to Nippur and to make a door out of it for the temple of Enlil, cf. l. 22: *lu-pu-uš* ᵍig *ša ga*?-*na ru-pu-ús-sa* [; 26: *a-na bi-ti* ᵈ*en-líl li-be-el pu-ra-tum* [; the piece deals with the same passage as Th. Bauer, JNES 16 (1957) 254 ff., but our text seems to have a fuller version. After l. 16 (= Bauer, l. 20): *mu-ša-bi i-li e-nu-na-ki pu*-x-*um-mi ip-te* it inserts a speech of Gilgameš? about the door. Remark on the Rev.? 34: *i-di-el a-bu-ul* [*qištim* ?]; cf. B. Landsberger, RA 62 (1968) 102 and note that ᵍig-kur-ra is common in Sumerian literature: ᵍig-kur-ra becomes: ᵍig-é-kur-ra! I did not finish my copy and with help of duplicates one can perhaps read more on the Rev. of which I do not possess a photograph. I publish it here as a help to read the photograph which I publish along with it.
